subject: general
question: Who among the following were the recipients of the 2025 Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought?

options.text: Dr. Sonali Ghosh and Peter Howitt

solution:
The correct answer is __**Andrzej Poczobut and Mzia Amaglobeli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2025 Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought** has been awarded to **Andrzej Poczobut** and **Mzia Amaglobeli** in recognition of their courageous fight for democracy and human rights in **Belarus** and **Georgia** respectively.
 
• **Andrzej Poczobut** is a prominent **Belarusian-Polish journalist** and a member of the **Union of Poles in Belarus**. He has been a consistent critic of **President Alexander Lukashenko's** authoritarian regime.
 
• In **February 2023**, **Poczobut** was sentenced to **eight years** in a high-security penal colony on charges of "inciting hatred" and "harming national security," which international observers have condemned as politically motivated.
